contexts.text: By intermediate Societies of Spirits and Angels...
Some were let out of that Hell, but the Lord disposed through intermediate Spirits and Angels that they could not injure me. SE 3360.
(Distance is judged of by the intermediate things.) HH 196. SE 2333. SE 3666:end.
It has often been given me to know what they were saying, by means of intermediate Spirits.
Both influx and communication, consequently conjunction, are signified by this intermediate. (The neck.)
That thus He might dispose the intermediates. Treated of.
An intermediate Spirit was given them, through whom they spoke with me... AC 6923. AC 9105. SE 3233.
There is also an intermediate, which communicates with both... the external and the internal... This Natural is what Jacob specifically represents.
What is intermediate. Signified, Explained.

The intermediate between the internal of the Natural and the external of the Rational is what is meant by the Spiritual of the Celestial, which is signified by Ephrath and Bethlehem, and is represented by Benjamin. This intermediate derives something from the internal of the Natural, which is Israel, and the external of the Rational, which is Joseph; for that which is intermediate must derive something from both things, otherwise it cannot serve as an intermediate. For anyone from spiritual to become celestial, he must necessarily progress by means of this intermediate. Without an intermediate it is not possible to climb to higher things. Treated of. AC 4585:end. AC 4592.
Benjamin = the spiritual truth which is from the celestial good which is Joseph; both together, therefore, are that intermediate which is between the spiritual man and the celestial man...
Thus both Benjamin and Joseph together represent the intermediate between the celestial and the spiritual man...

Each of them is intermediate between the celestial and the spiritual man, and therefore Joseph could not be conjoined... except through Benjamin; for without an intermediate no conjunction is possible.
Influx is not effected without an intermediate.
The internal of perception is closed with those (in faith alone), because there is no intermediate for the influx to pass through.
The intermediate to the truths of the Church, and to falsities. Signified, Explained.
This, therefore, is the intermediate, which is called the Celestial of the Spiritual from the Rational.
What is intermediate. Signified.
These are the regulators, and they are intermediate Spirits. Explained.
Opposites cannot be applied unless there are intermediates which conjoin. The intermediates which conjoin are the fallacies of the external senses. Example(s).
Intermediate primary things. Signified.
Of fifties = the intermediates between those truths which are in the second degree, and those which are in the third. Explained.

Intermediates are those things which accede to one part and proceed from the other, thus are between those which are in a prior degree, and those which are in a posterior one, for the sake of conjunction.
Not even to intermediates. Signified.

The extremity = intermediates; for the Celestial Kingdom... is distinguished from the Spiritual Kingdom... by intermediates. Through these, the Celestial Kingdom inflows into the Spiritual Kingdom; but not the reverse; for all influx is effected through intermediates from interiors to exteriors... from which it is evident that intermediates are extremities.
(Thus) Take heed not to touch the extremity of the mountain = that there must be no extension... even to intermediates.

By those who are in a general perception of celestial good, are meant those who are intermediate between the Celestial Kingdom and the Spiritual Kingdom; through whom, therefore, the influx, communication, and conjunction are effected.
These intermediate ones are represented by Moses.
Such cannot have any holy communication with the Lord, still less conjunction, except through an intermediate.
The presence of the Lord with them through an intermediate. Signified, Explained.
So that the externals of the Word and of worship might be presented to the Lord through an intermediate which was Moses.
Hence some idea may be formed concerning the intermediate which Closes represents...
How the case is with the intermediation which Moses now represents... namely, the holy external is the intermediate...
When Moses ascended the mountain, he represented the holy external of the Word, which is intermediate or mediate between its holy internal and the representative of the external sense.
That he might represent the intermediate, or that which mediates between the people and the Lord.
Hence may be evident the quality of the intermediate Angels who constitute the uniting medium which was represented by the veil.
The Hell of Genii is completely separated from the Hell of Spirits... There are intermediate ones there who conjoin; and who are opposite to the intermediate ones in the Heavens.
In proportion as Spirits and Angels differ as to affections and thoughts, they appear separated from each other; but still they are conjoined by means of intermediate ones when the Lord so pleases.
That which is not continually held in connection with the First by intermediates is at once... dissipated. HH 303.

The only communication (between the two Kingdoms) is through intermediate angelic Societies, which are called celestial spiritual... Hence, although Heaven is divided into two Kingdoms, still it makes a one. The Lord always provides such intermediate Angels, through whom is communication and conjunction.
When the Lord elevates any from a lower Heaven into a higher one... they are environed with intermediate Angels, through whom is communication.
Agreement and conjunction increase from plurality; for each thing therein is inserted as an intermediating relation between two or more...
Without intermediate Spirits, I could speak with them only by a species of active thought.
As good and evil are opposites, there exists what is intermediate, and equilibrium there...
The Angels cannot speak with man except through intermediate Spirits...
For there are intermediates between the interior man and the exterior...
They penetrate into the proximate or intermediate Societies, both evil and good.
Some said the evil Spirits above the head are evil, others that they are good, and others that they are intermediate...
Also the intermediates (of the ideas).
It has been granted to speak with angelic Spirits, but through an intermediate one...
There are also intermediate Spirits: these are sent among the spiritual ones...
There is no communication (between Genii and Spirits) except through intermediate ones, as between the celestial and the spiritual.
Those of (the Genii) who ratiocinate, are intermediate ones.
There are celestial things in the very syllables (of the Hebrew words in the Word) which are understood by the intermediate angels.
The spiritual Angels have an intermediate sense between the internal and the external senses.
They were separated... by means of intermediate loves...
It is usual in the Word to mention those things in the first place which take place in the last, because these include the intermediates...
Therefore they are called intermediate ends.
That thus He might rule and dispose ultimates from primes, and all intermediates from primes through ultimates.
As the celestial Angels are perfected in wisdom through the hearing, there are intermediate Angels, who are called celestial spiritual Angels, who preach and teach truths in their temples.
The force of creating... advances from the First through intermediates to the ultimate; the First is the Sun of Heaven... the intermediates are spiritual things...
There are also intermediate Angels, who are called spiritual celestial. Many of these are preachers in the highest Heaven.
